title: Membership Bit for a Circuit Value
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $j$ be a natural number. The associated bit is $1$ exactly when the pair encoding of the description of index $j$ for strings of length $|x|$, together with $x$, belongs to the circuit-value language; otherwise it is $0$.
caveat: The pair encoding, indexed description, and circuit-value language are not defined in the supplied payload.
